annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1821 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/1018 as regards Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS), U-space occurrences, part-IS occurrences, and the removal of certain aviation security occurrences from mandatory reporting requirements
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1821 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/1018 as regards Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS), U-space occurrences, part-IS occurrences, and the removal of certain aviation security occurrences from mandatory reporting requirements
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation amending the civil aviation mandatory occurrence reporting list. It adds a new Annex VI for unmanned aircraft systems requiring certificate or design declaration, adds U-space and information-security occurrences, and removes some aviation security occurrences, which are phased out from 2028 under the new security reporting system.
key_provisions_or_claims: New Annex VI lists mandatorily reportable UAS occurrences, limited to UAS operations requiring a certificate or design declaration.
UAS operations not needing certificate or declaration are excluded, keeping reporting proportionate to risk.
U-space-related occurrences added for UAS and manned aircraft.
Generic information security incident occurrences added across annexes.
Bomb threat, hijack and aerodrome security reporting applies only until 31 December 2027.
